summary: The reviewed commit is internally identifiable and the checkpoint hash matches the profile and validation report, but it is not release-recoverable: commit 8c1f9f5 is one commit ahead of its remote feature branch, the audit branch has no upstream, no v5.7.1 annotated tag exists, the current audit is uncommitted and incomplete, and no immutable commit-bound test or gate record establishes that validation ran on this commit. These are blocking repository-release failures; this role does not assess or override the outstanding scientific reviews.

evidence: Command `git branch --show-current; git rev-parse HEAD; git remote -v; git status --short --branch; git branch -vv` returned branch `audit-v571-post-remediation`, HEAD `8c1f9f53e4a1ab72e66a82ef31b8c675ab9e4bf9`, origin `https://github.com/dushyant-mishra/Drosophila-sperm-nuclei-segmentation.git`, and untracked `audits/runs/20260821-v571-post-remediation-final/`.

audits/runs/20260821-v571-post-remediation-final/manifest.json:5-11 records the same commit and branch and says `dirty_worktree: false`; this describes launch state, while the present untracked audit directory makes the current worktree non-clean.
Command `git branch -vv` showed no upstream for `audit-v571-post-remediation`; linked branch `feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet` was `[origin/feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet: ahead 1]`.
Command `git log --all --graph --decorate --oneline -15` placed local 8c1f9f5 above remote `origin/feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet` at fa69c83 and `origin/main` at de2ffd1.
Live `git ls-remote --heads --tags origin` could not be completed because network access to github.com:443 was unavailable.

Command `git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-status -r HEAD` identified 29 changed paths confined to v5.7.1 production code, profile, tests, documentation, audit registry/evidence, and supporting study/evidence scripts.
Command `git diff --stat; git diff --cached --stat` produced no tracked or staged differences; current dirt is limited to the untracked active audit-run directory.
Command `git status --ignored --short` reported ignored `audits/runs/20260821-v571-post-remediation-final/logs/` and `scratch/v571_remediation_final2_pilot/`.
`.gitignore:14-29` ignores logs, microscopy TIFF/PNG data, generated batch outputs, and `scratch/`; `.gitignore:46` excludes generated checkpoint files under tuning-result settings.
Command `git ls-files model_checkpoints production_profiles audits/evidence` confirmed that the selected checkpoint, production profile, and curated audit evidence are deliberately tracked.

V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:7-11 names `sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py`, `production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json`, `model_checkpoints/v571_model_c_dual_head_epoch003.pt`, and SHA-256 `7d49031dbcce31f0600c44146d9b5282b0df6e28bb1fc1bdde6ef2146ed15d25`.
production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:30-32 names the same checkpoint and SHA-256; line 209 declares pipeline version `v5.7.1-dual-head-width`.
Command `certutil -hashfile model_checkpoints\v571_model_c_dual_head_epoch003.pt SHA256` returned `7d49031dbcce31f0600c44146d9b5282b0df6e28bb1fc1bdde6ef2146ed15d25`.
audits/runs/20260821-v571-post-remediation-final/manifest.json:3-6 binds this audit run and claim to commit 8c1f9f53e4a1ab72e66a82ef31b8c675ab9e4bf9.
audits/claims_registry.json:5-8 records PIPELINE-V571-PRODUCTION-001 as high-risk and only `implemented`.
audits/claims_registry.json:55-58 still points to diagnostic run `20260821-v571-production-diagnostic` with `gate_passed: false` and `blocked_pending_remediation`.

audits/runs/20260821-v571-post-remediation-final/manifest.json:22-25 has `completed_at_utc: null` and an empty `role_exit_codes` object; no current `decision.json` or `gate_summary.json` was present in the untracked run directory.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:127-128 explicitly requires a fresh independent seven-role audit before release tagging.

V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:115-121 reports compilation, `196 passed in 26.04s`, focused tests, tuner self-check, and `git diff --check`, but provides no commit identifier, timestamp, environment manifest, command transcript, or archived log binding these results to 8c1f9f5.

Focused command `python -m pytest -q tests/test_saturn_v571_dual_head.py tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py tests/test_saturn_v571_audit_blockers.py tests/test_agent_audit_framework.py` could not run because the available Python 3.14 interpreter has no pytest module.
The repository-prescribed `.venv\Scripts\python.exe` from USER_GUIDE.md:932-936 is absent in this worktree.

Command `python scripts/validate_agent_audit.py --run audits/runs/20260821-v571-post-remediation-final` did not produce a gate result because the active read-only review run cannot write `gate_summary.json`; it exited with PermissionError.
audits/runs/20260821-v571-post-remediation-final/manifest.json:22-25 independently shows the run incomplete with no completion timestamp or role exit codes.
USER_GUIDE.md:939-942 states that any required conditional, fail, or abstain verdict or blocking finding prevents acceptance.

Command `git branch -vv` showed multiple divergent local branches, including `feature/v5.7.1-body-width` at 1600a39 without an upstream and `feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet` at 8c1f9f5 ahead of origin by one.
Command `git log --all --graph --decorate --oneline -15` showed `main` and `origin/main` remain at v5.7.0 commit de2ffd1 while the candidate exists only on local v5.7.1 branches.
Command `git tag --points-at HEAD` returned no tag for reviewed commit 8c1f9f5.
Command `git for-each-ref refs/tags --format=...` found only annotated tag `v5.7.0`, whose tag object points to de2ffd1; there is no v5.7.1 tag.
The current audit directory is untracked, and `git ls-files audits/runs` listed only the prior diagnostic audit; therefore the final audit and decision are not yet archived as immutable Git evidence.

Command `git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-status -r HEAD` showed curated PNG evidence under `audits/evidence/` but no raw TIFF stacks, scratch outputs, runtime logs, or batch-output directories added by commit 8c1f9f5.
.gitignore:1-2 excludes `gemini_api_key.txt`; `.gitignore:31-32` excludes private project history and private configuration.

Focused repository scan for API keys, passwords, private-key headers, GitHub tokens, and OpenAI-style keys found only documentation, variable names, environment-variable access, and ignored key-file references; no credential value was detected.
README.md:145-149 states that the diagnostic audit blocked production acceptance and that passing unit tests alone does not override it.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:123-128 describes a production replay but explicitly says a fresh seven-role audit is required before release tagging or a full biological rerun.
audits/claims_registry.json:50-52 preserves non-claims that the pilot does not establish a KJ-versus-WT biological effect and does not measure anatomical SV volume.

findings.title: Reviewed commit is not synchronized to a recoverable remote ref
findings.impact: Commit 8c1f9f5 could be lost with the local worktrees and cannot presently be recovered from the recorded origin branch; release provenance is incomplete.
evidence: `git branch -vv` reported `feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet` ahead of origin by one commit and no upstream for `audit-v571-post-remediation`.
`git log --all --graph --decorate --oneline -15` showed origin's v5.7.1 feature branch at fa69c83, below reviewed commit 8c1f9f5.
findings.recommendation: After all required reviews pass and explicit authorization is obtained, push the exact reviewed commit to a protected remote branch and record the resulting remote ref.

findings.title: No completed, immutable audit decision exists for this run
findings.impact: The high-risk claim cannot pass the release gate, and current reviewer results or the eventual decision could be lost because the run is untracked.
evidence: audits/runs/20260821-v571-post-remediation-final/manifest.json:22-25 records no completion time or role exit codes.
`git status --short --branch` reported the entire `audits/runs/20260821-v571-post-remediation-final/` directory as untracked.
audits/claims_registry.json:55-58 still records the prior blocked diagnostic decision.
findings.recommendation: Complete all required independent reviews, run the validator, create the coordinator decision without rewriting prior records, and archive the complete run plus decision in an immutable authorized commit.

findings.title: Tests are asserted but not durably bound to the reviewed commit
findings.impact: The release steward cannot verify that the reported 196-test result and focused remediation tests were executed against commit 8c1f9f5 rather than another worktree state.
evidence: V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:115-121 contains result summaries but no commit-bound transcript or artifact.
Focused pytest execution was unavailable because `.venv\Scripts\python.exe` is absent and system Python reports `No module named pytest`.
USER_GUIDE.md:932-936 prescribes the missing `.venv` interpreter for audit validation.
findings.recommendation: In a clean checkout of 8c1f9f5 with the documented environment, rerun the full unit suite, focused adversarial tests, compilation/self-checks, and audit validator; archive commands, environment identity, timestamps, commit hash, and outputs.

findings.title: No v5.7.1 annotated release tag or immutable release evidence
findings.impact: There is no immutable release identifier connecting code, profile, checkpoint, completed audit, and decision; the production candidate is not release-ready.
evidence: `git tag --points-at HEAD` returned no tag.
`git for-each-ref refs/tags` showed only annotated v5.7.0 at de2ffd1.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:127-128 correctly states that audit completion must precede release tagging.
findings.recommendation: Only after the gate passes and explicit user authorization is provided, create and push an annotated v5.7.1 tag referencing the accepted commit and archive the profile/checkpoint hash, test logs, audit run, and signed release decision.

findings.title: Live origin state could not be independently queried
findings.impact: Local remote-tracking refs demonstrate a missing push, but the exact current GitHub state and repository visibility could not be independently confirmed during this review.
evidence: `git ls-remote --heads --tags origin` failed to connect to github.com port 443.
Local `origin/feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet` remains at fa69c83 and local `origin/main` at de2ffd1.
findings.recommendation: Before publication, repeat `git fetch --prune` and `git ls-remote --heads --tags origin` in a network-enabled authorized session, then verify branch protection and release visibility.

limitations: No other reviewers' output files were read.
No full image stack or full biological study was run.
Focused tests could not execute because the repository virtual environment is absent and the available system interpreter lacks pytest.
The audit validator writes `gate_summary.json`; the required read-only session prevented that write, so the gate was assessed from the incomplete manifest and missing artifacts instead.
Remote GitHub state could not be refreshed because network access was unavailable.
recommended_follow_up: Complete all seven independent reviews and preserve this failing repository-release verdict in the append-only audit run.
Provision the documented test environment and rerun tests and audit validation on a clean checkout of exactly 8c1f9f53e4a1ab72e66a82ef31b8c675ab9e4bf9 with immutable logs.
Obtain explicit authorization before pushing, merging, or tagging; then synchronize the accepted commit and create an annotated v5.7.1 tag.

Archive the completed audit, gate summary, decision, test provenance, production profile, and verified checkpoint SHA-256 together, then update the claims registry through the authorized audit workflow.
